growth_drivers: USA Rare Earth Inc. acquired a 13.6% equity interest in Carester SAS for $45.7 million.
USA Rare Earth announced the first commercial production of yttrium metal, positioning itself among a limited number of such producers outside China.
USA Rare Earth Inc. plans to expand its rare earth magnet manufacturing capacity to meet anticipated growth in demand across various sectors.
risks: Gross margin declined to a negative 27.2% in Q2'2026 due to increased raw material costs.
USA Rare Earth must establish a $250.0 million revolving credit facility by June 30, 2027.
The Serra Verde acquisition will require $300.0 million in cash consideration.

growth_drivers: Engaged over 30 potential customers, including large multinationals.
Received production purchase orders from customers in the industrial motion control sector and aerospace and defense sector.
Building a multiyear relationship with a customer turns the purchase order into a durable form of customer intimacy.
Acquiring Serra Verde for light and heavy rare earths and investing in Carester for processing capability.
Building the global leader in rare earths, essential for modern economy sectors.
risks: Active engagement with alternative supply sources and expectations of positive momentum in pricing.

growth_drivers: The company expects to expand demand beyond 2,500 tons annually with new customers.
USA Rare Earth Inc. is creating a global supply chain outside of China, focusing on heavy rare earths.
USA Rare Earth has 12 MOUs and is ramping up Stillwater's capacity to 1,200 metric tons by early next year.
Swarf from magnet production could represent 20% to 30% of raw material oxides.
